title: 服务业扩张不及预期：物价指数创阶段新高，就业却意外收缩
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: ISM Services Index rises to 54.1 from 54, so not a huge change service industries are apparently hanging in there.
segments.zh: ISM服务业指数从54升至54.1，变化不大，服务业似乎仍在稳步扩张。

segments.en: 54.5 was the forecast, so it's not as good as anticipated. Price is paid, that's the bad news.
segments.zh: 预期为54.5，实际略逊预期。物价支付指数上升，这是不利消息。

segments.en: Up to 70.3 from 67.7 and the new orders index is a little higher, 57.2 from 55.1, but employment,
segments.zh: 物价支付指数从67.7升至70.3，新订单指数从55.1升至57.2，但就业指数从51.2降至47.4，就业表现疲软。

segments.en: 47.4 from 51.2 so employment is weaker and we saw rise in employment for the manufacturing PMI on Monday,
segments.zh: 就业指数从51.2降至47.4，就业走弱。周一公布的制造业PMI中就业指数上升，两者形成对比。

segments.en: so manufacturing went up more and the employment index went up more and the prices index fell a little bit in manufacturing, so the manufacturing and service industries have sort of flipped
segments.zh: 制造业就业指数上升更多，物价指数小幅下降，制造业和服务业的动能似乎发生了互换。

segments.en: in terms of who's got the momentum. Did we see that reflected in 80 P2 because I was struck this morning, leisure hospitality sector shed 11,000 jobs in July. I wonder if there's something
segments.zh: 这种动能转换是否在ADP数据中有所体现？今早我注意到，休闲酒店业7月减少了1.1万个岗位，这背后可能另有原因。

segments.en: going on there and maybe if it's world cup related, over hiring, you let people go sort of thing?
segments.zh: 或许与世界杯有关，前期过度招聘，现在进行人员调整。

segments.en: It probably is because you had a huge hiring earlier in the summer, even earlier than economists anticipated. When you look at the rest of what ADP was telling us, manufacturing added only 2,000
segments.zh: 很可能如此，因为夏季早些时候招聘强劲，甚至超出经济学家预期。ADP数据还显示，制造业仅新增2000个岗位。

segments.en: jobs, 1,000 in construction, so not a lot of jobs in manufacturing or services other than healthcare,
segments.zh: 建筑业新增1000个岗位，制造业和服务业除医疗保健外，新增就业都不多。

segments.en: which is always the big gator. Right, Mike, just the other piece of data, we also got this morning, I know you spoke about it on surveillance, was the quarterly refunding announcement.
segments.zh: 医疗保健一直是就业增长的主要动力。另外，今早还公布了季度再融资公告，Mike，你在《Surveillance》中提过。
